scheme_name: Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme
description:
The Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme was launched by the Government of India on 1st April 2019. 

This scheme is specifically designed to promote savings among women. 

It aims to empower women financially by encouraging them to save for their future. 

The scheme is named after Kasturba Gandhi, the wife of Mahatma Gandhi, who was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and a symbol of women's empowerment. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide women with a secure investment option that yields a higher interest rate compared to regular savings accounts. 

The scheme targets women who are looking for a safe and reliable way to grow their savings. 

The interest rate offered under this scheme is 7.5 percent per annum. 

This interest rate is significantly higher than the average savings account interest rate in India, which typically ranges from 3 to 4 percent. 

The term deposit can be made for a minimum period of 1 year and a maximum period of 5 years. 

The minimum deposit amount required to open a term deposit under this scheme is ₹1,000. 

There is no maximum limit on the amount that can be deposited. 

The scheme allows for premature withdrawal, but this may incur a penalty. 

In the case of premature withdrawal, the interest rate may be reduced to the prevailing savings account rate. 

The scheme is open to all women above the age of 18 years. 

There are no specific income criteria to qualify for this scheme. 

Women from all economic backgrounds can apply for this scheme. 

The application process for the Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants need to visit their nearest bank branch that offers this scheme. 

They must fill out the application form provided by the bank. 

The required documents include a government-issued photo ID, proof of address, and a passport-sized photograph. 

Once the application is submitted along with the required documents, the bank will process the request. 

The term deposit receipt will be issued upon successful completion of the application process. 

The scheme also allows for joint accounts, where a woman can open a term deposit account with another woman. 

This feature is particularly beneficial for women who may not have a steady income but want to save together with a family member or friend. 

The interest earned on the deposits is credited to the account on a quarterly basis. 

This means that women can see their savings grow more frequently compared to annual interest crediting. 

The scheme also provides the option for auto-renewal of the term deposit upon maturity. 

This feature ensures that the savings continue to grow without the need for the account holder to take any action. 

The Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. 

The scheme is administered through various nationalized banks and financial institutions across the country. 

Women can inquire about the scheme and its benefits by contacting their local bank branch. 

Additionally, the official website of the Ministry of Finance provides detailed information about the scheme. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch, with many women taking advantage of the higher interest rates. 

As of the latest reports, over 1 million women have opened accounts under this scheme. 

The total amount deposited in the scheme has exceeded ₹2,500 crores. 

This demonstrates the growing interest among women in financial savings and investments. 

The scheme also aligns with the government's broader initiative to promote financial inclusion among women. 

By providing a safe and attractive savings option, the scheme encourages women to take charge of their financial futures. 

The government has also launched awareness campaigns to educate women about the benefits of this scheme. 

These campaigns aim to reach women in rural and semi-urban areas where financial literacy may be lower. 

The Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at women. 

Other schemes include the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme and the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana. 

These initiatives collectively work towards improving the socio-economic status of women in India. 

The success of the Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme can be measured by the increasing number of accounts opened and the total deposits made. 

The government continues to monitor the scheme's performance and make adjustments as necessary to enhance its effectiveness. 

In conclusion, the Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme is a significant step towards empowering women financially. 

With its attractive interest rates and straightforward application process, it serves as a valuable tool for women looking to secure their financial future. 

The scheme not only promotes savings but also encourages women to become active participants in the economy. 

By fostering a culture of saving among women, the scheme contributes to the overall economic development of the country. 

Women interested in this scheme should take advantage of the benefits it offers and consider opening a term deposit account. 

This initiative is an excellent opportunity for women to build their savings and work towards financial independence.
